verdict.rationale: Watchtower reviews every interaction against natural-language criteria and flags issues such as policy violations. Duet automatically iterates on the agent as conversations reveal gaps, and Suggestions drafts fixes for knowledge gaps, so the flag-and-feed-back loop is documented. Missing for 10: explicit QA scoring or scorecards of sampled conversations, a documented human reviewer workflow linking flagged items to fixes, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing).

support.subject: As a support ops lead, AI conversations get ongoing QA — scored samples, flagged failures, and a review loop that feeds fixes back into the agent

citations.quote: Watchtower reviews every interaction against your custom criteria and surfaces what matters most.
From "mentions of frustration" to "violations of data privacy policy," Watchtower understands your flagging criteria and applies your intent contextually.
As conversations reveal gaps and new opportunities, Duet automatically iterates on your agent, from the first launch through every improvement after.
It automatically detects knowledge gaps and generates content drafts based on how your best human agents resolved those same issues
